OpenAI 今日確認，ChatGPT and Codex users can now add multiple Gmail and Google Cal accounts. Here's the details.

「Add a second (or third!) account」

Depending on how you split your work and personal life, you probably have more than one Gmail or Google Calendar account.

For many users who rely on ChatGPT's plugins for these platforms, one limitation has remained: each plugin could only connect to one Google account, making it difficult to use different personal and work email accounts or calendars simultaneously in ChatGPT Codex.

OpenAI DX engineer Gabriel Chua confirmed today that the company has rolled out multi-account support for Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Contacts.

To add another account, users can open the "Plugins" section in the sidebar, find Gmail, Google Calendar, or Google Contacts, click on the gear icon of the connected plugin, where you can add a second or third account and complete the standard Google authorization process.

In practice, this change means a user could handle information or take actions through their personal Gmail in one ChatGPT conversation, while simultaneously using a different conversation to handle work matters through their work account, contacts, and calendar.

ChatGPT can also pull relevant information from multiple connected accounts when needed, giving it a more complete picture of your communications, relationships, and schedule—enabling more useful, context-aware responses.

It's worth noting that the OpenAI plugin documentation states that connected accounts are subject to the permissions and workspace settings of each application, so actual availability may vary depending on a user's plan type, organization, and admin configurations.
